sampledMemoryPeaks.caveat: Timer samples can still miss shorter spikes; the values include runner and in-process current server memory.

result.sampledQueueMaximumCaveat: Queue depth maxima are only periodic health samples. Replacement/failure counters are connection-lifetime values for connections still active at each sample, so reconnecting a client can remove its earlier counters from later aggregate health values.

controllers.caveat: Action counts are client sends, not proof of ControllerRegistry acceptance or fixed-step application.
